title: TELECOMM, a client/server test tool
description: A client and server text tool built on ENet. Its traffic can be routed through other programs.
run:
To host (you start the session): just run telecomm.exe.
To connect to someone else's session: open a command prompt and run telecomm.exe followed by the host's IP address, for example: telecomm.exe 127.0.0.1
